The paint is peeling, revealing layers of texture and grime. Above the doors are small, rectangular windows with dark frames, looking out onto what appears to be an exterior or another bright space. The lighting is high-contrast, with bright light streaming through the open doorways on the left, creating deep shadows in the corridor. The overall atmosphere is gritty, aged, and institutional.
